headline: Congress in recess mode: Both chambers call light pro forma sessions as legislators head to the hills for August break.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Monday, August 17, conducting only routine business before adjourning for a recess that will extend through mid-August. No substantive legislation was debated or voted on.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly on Monday, August 17 for a pro forma session lasting just eight minutes. Nine new bills and one resolution were introduced, but no votes were held as the chamber prepares for the August recess period.
